about_the_game:
The debut of BLACKHAT espionage is an engaging, playable cinematic story about Brian, a newly employed special agent working for the Department of Cybersecurity Terrorism, when he is pulled into a task force during an imminent cyber terrorist alert. In episode one, the series pilot, Brian is sent by the regional director to investigate an SOS breach alert from a fellow analyst. You must use the clues to find out what happened, and recover the hard drive and any evidence.

This game release is BLACKHAT espionage, and includes Episode 1: Recovery

  • Search and find out what happened to Aaron, a fellow analyst on the task force.

  • Find and recover the Hard drive which contains an algorithm created by an ancient prophet.

  • Collect any evidence to help decipher code and find the Hard drive.

content_descriptors.notes: Game depicts scene of insinuated force prescription drug overdose, and non-sexual, non-revealing adult clothed in undergarments; boxers and t-shirt.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600, 3.5Ghz, 6 Core(s), 12 Logical Processors
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek Digital Output (Stereo)
  • Additional Notes: Recommended use of an SSD hard drive. *The game may run on lower spec hardware, but this is the limit of the lowest spec development system available to us for testing and verification at time of publication.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor, 3.8Ghz, 12 Core(s), 24 Logical Processors
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: U-Phoria UMC 1820
  • Additional Notes: Recommended use of an M.2 hard drive

short_description: A newly hired cybersecurity specialist gets pulled in over his head as he unravels mysterious code hidden by an ancient prophet. You must use the clues to find and recover the missing hard drive and any evidence.
